name: Community — Qwen Image 2.1
author: michaeldune
description: Qwen-Image 2.1, the 7B model that writes, edits and cuts out in one: text-to-image with accurate lettering, editing from up to four reference pictures, and background removal to a real transparent PNG. A fourth card turns one picture of a person into a front / back / head-angles character sheet (adds a 328 MB LoRA). About 16 seconds for a 1024 px picture on a 12 GB card. One 17 GB download covers every card. LICENCE: the weights are under the Qwen Research License, which allows NON-COMMERCIAL use only; do not use these cards for paid or commercial work.

presets.name: Qwen Image 2.1
presets.tagline: Fast text-to-image with lettering that spells
presets.description: Text-to-image with Qwen-Image 2.1. Follows long natural-language prompts and renders quoted text on signs, labels and posters correctly. For a transparent result, start the prompt with: This is an RGBA image with transparency. and end it with: The image has alpha channel and the background is transparent. Non-commercial use only (Qwen Research License).

extensions.name: rgthree-comfy
extensions.description: Power Lora Loader, used by SimpliGen's own LoRA slot. Usually pre-installed.

requirements.notes: LICENCE: Qwen Research License, non-commercial use only (https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1/blob/main/LICENSE). All three cards share one set of weights from Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1: the int8 ConvRot model (7.3 GB), the int8 ConvRot Qwen3-VL 8B text encoder (9.4 GB) and the 2.1 VAE (0.7 GB). Official template settings: 25 steps, CFG 1, euler/simple. Needs ComfyUI v0.37.0 or newer (the first release with Qwen-Image 2.1 support, core commit 6bfaacc67). Tested 2026-09-20 on a 4070 Ti 12 GB (stock ComfyUI master): 16 s per 1024x1024 or 1344x768 picture at 25 steps, about 9.4 GB VRAM in use; a five-word shop sign came out letter-perfect; the RGBA prompt produced real alpha.

presets.name: Qwen Image 2.1 Edit
presets.tagline: Edit or combine up to four pictures by describing the change
presets.description: Describe the edit in plain words and refer to the pictures by position: Keep the woman in <image1> unchanged, put the jacket from <image2> on her. One to four reference pictures; each extra one adds time (about 20 s for one, 50 s for two, 105 s for four on a 12 GB card). The result uses the aspect ratio you pick, so choose the one that matches your first picture when the framing should stay the same. Non-commercial use only (Qwen Research License).

requirements.notes: LICENCE: Qwen Research License, non-commercial use only (https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1/blob/main/LICENSE). All three cards share one set of weights from Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1: the int8 ConvRot model (7.3 GB), the int8 ConvRot Qwen3-VL 8B text encoder (9.4 GB) and the 2.1 VAE (0.7 GB). Official template settings: 25 steps, CFG 1, euler/simple. Needs ComfyUI v0.37.0 or newer (the first release with Qwen-Image 2.1 support, core commit 6bfaacc67). Reference loaders use the sgopt_ optional-slot naming, so the app removes an empty slot and its images.image_N input before the job is queued; one encoder serves one to four pictures. References are resized to about 1 MP before encoding (the node's resolution input). Every extra reference lengthens the sequence: on a 4070 Ti 12 GB one reference took 22 s, two took 52 s and four took 106 s at 25 steps (2026-09-20, stock ComfyUI master); identity, a sticker character, a lettered sign and a street scene all carried into one four-reference picture.

presets.name: Qwen Image 2.1 Cutout
presets.tagline: Remove the background, get a transparent PNG
presets.description: One picture in, the subject out on a transparent background, hair and soft edges included. The instruction is built in; use the prompt box only to say what to keep (for example: keep the microphone and the cable). The result always has the size and shape of your picture; the aspect ratio setting is ignored. Non-commercial use only (Qwen Research License).

All three cards share one set of weights from Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1: the int8 ConvRot model (7.3 GB), the int8 ConvRot Qwen3-VL 8B text encoder (9.4 GB) and the 2.1 VAE (0.7 GB). Official template settings: 25 steps, CFG 1, euler/simple. Needs ComfyUI v0.37.0 or newer (the first release with Qwen-Image 2.1 support, core commit 6bfaacc67). Samples on the latent the encoder returns for the reference, so the cut-out lines up with the source pixel for pixel (rounded to a multiple of 32, about 1 MP). The brief is the model card's own (Remove the background, and output a PNG image) plus a keep-the-whole-subject sentence, with {{prompt}} appended as extra notes. The bare model-card line followed by an empty prompt deleted the subject's jacket and hair on 1 of 3 seeds; with the keep sentence 18 of 18 portrait renders were identical in coverage. Card template tested on a portrait, a B&W profile, a sneaker on a cluttered bench and a long-haired dog, two seeds each: 8 of 8 clean, 16-22 s. A picture with no clear subject (a street scene) comes back mostly or fully transparent.

presets.name: Qwen Image 2.1 Character Sheet
presets.tagline: One picture of a person in, a front / back / head-angles sheet out
presets.description:
Turns one picture of a person into a character reference sheet on a white background: a large head in the middle, a headless full-body front view on the left, a full-body back view on the right, and two small side profiles facing each other underneath. The layout comes from the Portrait2CharRef LoRA by b675051045971, which is built in, and so is the brief; the prompt box is only for extra notes.

PICTURE 1 (required) = the person. A full-body picture keeps the whole outfit, bag and shoes included. A head-and-shoulders portrait works too, but the clothes below the shoulders are then invented and change with the seed.
PICTURE 2 (optional) = an outfit. Add a picture of clothes and the sheet dresses the person in them.

SET THE ASPECT RATIO TO 3:2. The LoRA was trained for that shape and other shapes break the layout. About 30 s on a 12 GB card, about 50 s with an outfit picture. The large head keeps the angle of your picture, so use a front-facing one for a front-facing head. The back view sometimes keeps its head; only the front view is meant to be headless.

Non-commercial use only (Qwen Research License). The LoRA itself is free to use (Civitai, all permissions open).

extensions.name: rgthree-comfy
extensions.description: Power Lora Loader, used by SimpliGen's own LoRA slot. Usually pre-installed.

requirements.notes: LICENCE: Qwen Research License, non-commercial use only (https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1/blob/main/LICENSE). All three cards share one set of weights from Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1: the int8 ConvRot model (7.3 GB), the int8 ConvRot Qwen3-VL 8B text encoder (9.4 GB) and the 2.1 VAE (0.7 GB). Official template settings: 25 steps, CFG 1, euler/simple. Needs ComfyUI v0.37.0 or newer (the first release with Qwen-Image 2.1 support, core commit 6bfaacc67). This card adds the Portrait2CharRef LoRA (Civitai model 2954346 v1.0 by b675051045971, 328 MB, public, permissions: no credit needed, commercial use and derivatives allowed; sha256 pinned in the pack checksums) through LoraLoaderModelOnly at strength 1, ahead of SimpliGen's own LoRA slot. The brief is the author's Chinese training prompt (with its 又测 typo corrected to 右侧); a lazy switch picks a second wording, 人物穿着图2的服装, when picture 2 is supplied - the sgopt_ flag for slot 2 disappears with the empty slot, leaving Or(false). Tested 2026-09-21 in the app through the Edit card with the same LoRA and brief, 3:2 (1216x832), seeds 4242/4243, 9 runs: layout correct 9 of 9 (headless front, mirrored profiles), identity held 9 of 9; sources were two studio portraits, a head crop of the author's own example, a full-body street photo (coat, scarf, sweater, bag, trousers and boots all kept on both seeds) and a portrait plus an outfit-only picture (suit applied, face kept). Without the LoRA the base model keeps the front figure's head and draws both profiles facing the same way. 2 of 9 back views kept the head.
